user.title: Select the LD2401 control device
user.description: No device could be recognised automatically (a renamed device that has not advertised yet). Choose the radar to control; its Bindkey is taken from the same entry.

reconfigure.title: Update LD2401 control settings
reconfigure.description: The Bindkey follows the built-in BTHome integration automatically, so only the ESPHome action needs to be set here.

data.esphome_action: ESPHome action (domain.service, or empty for automatic)

data_description.esphome_action: Leave empty to broadcast from the ESPHome node that currently hears the radar.

abort.no_devices_found: No device with a Bindkey was found in the built-in BTHome integration. Add the radar there first; its entry is then created here automatically.
abort.no_bthome_entry: The built-in BTHome integration has no entry with a Bindkey for this device yet.
abort.user_removed: This entry was removed earlier and is not recreated automatically; add it again from this flow if you want it back.
